title: Egyptian Bean Fritters
description: A flavorful and crispy Egyptian-inspired snack made with beans, flaky pastry, and aromatic spices.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine refried beans, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper. Mix well.
2. Add crushed flatbread to the bowl and mix until well combined.
3. Add beaten egg to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
4. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
5. Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the skillet.
6. Flatten the balls slightly with a spatula.
7. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
8. Remove from heat and serve hot.
